# Dynasty Futures

> Dynasty Futures is a proprietary trading firm offering simulated funded accounts to qualified futures traders.

## About

Dynasty Futures provides evaluation programs where traders can demonstrate their skills on simulated accounts. Successful traders receive funded accounts with profit-sharing arrangements. The firm focuses on futures markets and offers multiple plan tiers (Standard, Advanced, Builder) with account sizes ranging from $25,000 to $150,000.
